source: GitHub issue #8 and user clarification: business ownership must guide every map-writing and maintenance task; initialization only exposed the failure.

evals.prompt: 为这个项目初始化业务模块图谱。
evals.expected_output: A source-supported project map with separate business-owned YAML files and selectable business domains, preserving shared order/event identity and collaboration.
expectations: Creates multiple business-owned YAML documents without receiving a file-splitting instruction; partition covers purchasing, shipment fulfillment, and revenue reporting with evidence-backed boundaries rather than src/actions versus src/records.
Uses meaningful top-level business domain nodes and containment; Viewer can select the distinct business areas rather than only one project umbrella.
Defines the shared Order and Order placed event concepts once; publishing, consuming and shared-data references connect the source-supported collaborators across files.
Relations are declared in the source concept document and flows in their scenario document; stable flow steps preserve at least the dispatch allowed/refused outcomes supported by source.
All generated YAML documents validate together, rendered project/domain views retain cross-domain boundary concepts and relevant flows remain navigable.
No fabricated candidate/task origin or maintenance observation is recorded for direct initialization; Git diff, evidence and review/integration status are reported accurately.

evals.prompt: 为这个小项目初始化业务图谱。
evals.expected_output: One bounded business-domain YAML for appointment cancellation, without splitting technical directories into business domains.
expectations: Creates one business-owned YAML covering appointment cancellation; HTTP/rules/storage are source anchors, not artificial independent business domains.
Represents the cancellation deadline, durable appointment state, and accepted/refused outcomes in a source-supported scenario flow.
Complete graph validation passes and the Viewer presents the one meaningful domain with its flow.
Does not manufacture candidate origins or post-integration observation results; reports the actual review and integration boundary.

evals.prompt: 配送功能已经接入，请根据当前代码和产品说明补全已有业务图谱，并核对原有关系是否仍然成立。
evals.expected_output: A maintained business map preserves the valid order domain and shared identities while adding the independent warehouse fulfillment responsibility in its own domain-owned document.
expectations: Uses the existing map as evidence rather than its sole ownership boundary: adds a meaningful independently selectable fulfillment business domain and owning YAML without receiving a file-splitting instruction.
Preserves valid orders/place/cancel behavior and the stable orders.record, orders.placed and orders.place.flow identities; no duplicated Order or Order placed concept is introduced.
Records shipment request consumption of orders.placed and shared order reads/writes with relations declared in the source concept document. Existing order publication remains represented.
Models the supported dispatch decision and success/refusal outcomes in the fulfillment scenario document, rather than treating receipt of an event as successful delivery.
All documents validate together; the Viewer has order and fulfillment scopes with relevant external boundary concepts and related flows.
Keeps the change within order/fulfillment evidence, reports real Git review/integration state, and does not invent retained origins or claim a multi-file maintenance observation.
